No source code or controls are changed in what I could see, so there is no behavior change to regress.

The supplied text documents the cluster paged KV, cluster SSD prefix record encoding, GPT-OSS/MiMo/Gemma batch lanes and manifest pins. It is relevant to T-041, the retained prefix-cache threat. It describes the encrypted SSD tier as sealing the encoding in the record header, refusing and deleting foreign-encoding records, and binding the encoding into the load agreement. It also describes mixed-precision ranks refusing to load, fail-closed behavior, and verbatim-row retention so that restore cycles do not drift. These statements are consistent with T-041's mitigations and add no new contradiction or unmitigated surface in the visible text.

The docs make claims about code behavior (e.g. fail-closed load agreement, manifest repair only replacing identical-artifact bytes) that I cannot verify without the source. Docs-only change; no findings.
